FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 07/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 07.10.2026 ;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray would not be available.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Maulik J. Shelat)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice D. N. Ray.)
By Order of Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
